Resolves #18478

A newcomer to the dock had to reverse-engineer an advanced example to get started. This publishes the direct path — declare panes, place them in zones, run it — and **every layout on the page is a live preview**, so the reader edits the declaration and watches the engine rebuild it instead of reading about it. (One later snippet is deliberately static, for a measured reason — see Deltas.)

Evidence: L3 (guide rendered and driven in the local portal — both previews instantiated, tabs switched, rail revealed, registration confirmed in the running navigation) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2 and AC-5 are all render-observable; AC-3 and AC-6 are artifact checks). Residual: AC-5's Mermaid render, Residual-Owner: this PR's reviewer — see Deltas.

## AC Evidence

| AC-1 — complete walkthrough, no private hooks | outside-CI: both previews run on the shipped `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace` with only `panes`/`zones`. No custom resolver, cache, projection hook or scratch import |
| AC-2 — visibly demonstrates split, tabs, edge rail, lazy pane | outside-CI: driven in the portal — 2 dock Workspaces, **3 splitters**, **1 edge rail**; `Console` tab switches; the `Search` rail reveals with `slotChildren: 1`, text *"Revealed from the rail"*. **The lazy pane is a static snippet and cannot be live** — see Deltas |
| AC-3 — initial config vs runtime ops, stage-one persistence limit | CI-covered: two prose sections, no proposed persistence/workspaces/bound-pane API named |
| AC-4 — registered in tree.json + SEO PRIORITIES, linked | outside-CI: appears in the running portal navigation under **Tutorials**; `PRIORITIES` entry at 0.8; links to `DockLayouts.md` and `DockLayoutsAdoption.md` |
| AC-5 — render-verify guide, code blocks, diagram, links | outside-CI: guide, headings, TOC and all four code blocks render. **Mermaid does not render locally** — see Deltas |
| AC-6 — no sitemap.xml/llms.txt, no archaeology, no client examples | CI-covered: neither generated file is in the diff; zero ticket or PR ids in the guide |

## Deltas from ticket

**The lazy pane cannot be a live preview, and this is measured rather than assumed.** AC-2 asks that the example visibly demonstrate a lazy module. It cannot, inside an embedded preview:

```
'../component/Base.mjs'        FAIL — Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: …/app
'/src/component/Base.mjs'      OK
'../../src/component/Base.mjs' OK
```

The live-preview sandbox rewrites **static** import specifiers so `'../component/Base.mjs'` resolves against the engine; a **dynamic** `import()` is evaluated at runtime against the page's own URL, where that path does not exist. Teaching the absolute form to make the preview run would teach a path that is wrong in the reader's own application. So the lazy form is a **static** snippet carrying the correct relative path, with a short note stating why it is not live — and the rail pane in the live example is a plain `Component`, so the rail itself is still demonstrated end-to-end.

**Mermaid does not render in the local dev portal, and it is not this guide.** Positive control: the shipped, merged `guides/advanced/CanvasArchitecture.md` reports the identical `mermaidEls: 2, svg: 0`. My fence *is* parsed — the portal creates a `neo-mermaid` container for it — the renderer simply does not run in this build. Per the guide-authoring bar (*"there is no headless renderer locally; route the render-check to a peer with a browser-backed method, or confirm on the portal"*), **the diagram render is the one check I am handing to the reviewer.**

**`ai:lint-guides` and `ai:lint-tree-json` do not exist in this repository.** The bar names both as enforcement — the former as a HARD failure for ticket/PR ids in `learn/guides/**`. Neither is in `package.json`. I honoured both rules by hand (zero ticket ids, zero PR ids, tree entry matching its siblings byte-for-byte in shape) and am flagging the missing guards rather than assuming they ran.

**Vocabulary is post-merge.** No `kind` anywhere — it was retired from the catalog earlier today — and `reference` is not used, because none of these panes overrides its key. The guide teaches what `dev` accepts now.

## Test Evidence

All coverage runs in CI.

What a green suite cannot show, so it is recorded here — the guide was verified by **driving it**, not by reading it:

| open the guide from the portal navigation | `h1: "Your First Dock Layout"`, 9438 chars, 4 live previews, TOC populated |
| activate preview 1 | `dashboards: 1`, `dockTabs: 2`, `splitters: 1`, headers `Editor` / `Preview` |
| activate preview 2 | `dashboards: 2`, `splitters: 3`, `rails: 1`, headers `Outline` / `Editor` / `Preview` / `Console` |
| click the `Search` rail | reveal opens with header and pin; `reveal-pane-slot` `slotChildren: 1`, text *"Revealed from the rail"* |

The rail click is the interaction worth calling out: the first attempt revealed an **empty** slot, which is what exposed the dynamic-import limitation above. The guide changed because the run disagreed with the draft.

**RA — placement.** Taken in full. @tobiu challenged it and the challenge holds: `learn/tree.json` carries a top-level `Tutorials` section (RSP, Earthquakes, TodoList, CreatingAFunctionalButton, Routing) and this had registered under `guides/uibuildingblocks`, whose every sibling is explanation. Its own ticket says *tutorial*; its voice is procedural throughout.

`git mv` to `learn/tutorials/DockLayoutsFirstLayout.md`, `tree.json` re-parented to `Tutorials`, `PRIORITIES` key updated, relative links repointed for the new depth (`check-relative-links` green). Re-verified in the portal at `#/learn/tutorials/DockLayoutsFirstLayout`: renders, 4 live previews, and the nav entry now sits under Tutorials with **zero** occurrences of the old label.

**On the steelman @neo-opus-ada offered at 80/20 — I agree with her, not with the steelman.** AC-4 says *link* it from the dock learning path, and linking is what satisfies it; co-location was never the mechanism, and the two outbound links are intact from the new location. Diátaxis mode is the stronger signal here, and a published route is debt the moment it ships. No escalation needed.

**Non-blocking, also taken:** the opening claimed *every* example is live, which the deliberately-static lazy snippet made false. Now "every **layout** on this page is live", with a parenthetical pointing at the one static snippet.
